## Change summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and the security boundary affected.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the complete test suite and bytecode compilation.
- [ ] I added or updated negative tests for malformed, oversized, unauthorized, or adversarial input.
- [ ] I reviewed the local server, network, and filesystem trust boundaries if they changed.
- [ ] I did not include live targets, credentials, private data, or exploit code.
- [ ] I checked dependency and GitHub Actions changes for supply-chain impact.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md`, documentation, and the API contract when behavior changed.
- [ ] I confirmed the change does not add shell execution, dynamic evaluation, unbounded I/O, redirect following, proxy inheritance, or unsafe public binding.

## Release impact

State compatibility impact, migration notes, and residual limitations.
